description: Jet 4 MDB: 6xzx open edge — Phase 1 (same Workspace) and Phase 2 (two Workspaces): open db1 RW (False, False), open db2 ReadOnly (False, True), verify Updatable, db1 INSERTs, then db1.Close() while db2 stays open. Checks whether db2.Updatable stays -1 after db1.Close(), whether db2.Execute(INSERT) and dynaset Edit/Update succeed, and tracks 0xE02 / page-1 extent across db1.Close, db2 writes, 1500ms pause, and db2.Close.
